operations.title: Entry 1154 falsifies the naive elliptic-to-K3 polygon ladder
operations.body: Entry 1154 is verified. The general one-loop Baikov polynomial is quadratic in squared edge variables, hence quartic in edge variables for every polygon. After one linear marked-Cut residue, the four-site infinity branch is a quartic in P2; its double cover has K=-pi*H and degree-two del Pezzo type, not K3. Thus the three-site elliptic boundary is a dimension-specific coincidence, supporting H2 over a strong universal-coefficient ladder. Next frontier is the actual four-site marked divisor and relative cohomology over this frozen del Pezzo boundary.
